shortDescription: Get information on IIS Web Applications

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the web application. When not specified, information of all existing applications will be fetched or if site is specified, all applications under the site will be fetched.

options.name: site
options.description: Name of the site on which the application is created. When not specified, information of all existing applications will be fetched unless name is specified. Can be used in conjunction with name to fetch information for a specific application when name is not unique.
